data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 1.1m (2015: run-off deviation of GBP 0.4m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2012 and 2013 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a favourable run-off deviation (release) of GBP 1.1 million in 2016, primarily due to reserve movements on the 2012 and 2013 years of account for Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003. This represents a release of approximately 1.36% of the opening gross claims outstanding. No specific named events were identified as contributing to this movement, nor was the movement broken down by specific lines of business.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year release)
reserve movements on the 2012 and 2013 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle on page 15 shows no change in ultimate estimates for prior underwriting years when comparing the 'As at 31 December 2015' row to the latest estimates in the triangle, which contradicts the explicit prior year release stated in Note 9. Note 9 is used as the primary source for prior year development.
